selection: positive train mean daily RankIC; maximum validation mean daily RankIC; tie alphabetical; no re-selection after test
signal: after day t close; buy next day open and sell next day close; top 3 equally weighted; no short; require volume > 0 and valid OHLC
label: close[t+1]/open[t+1]-1; purge last date of each split
costs: per side 1 bp fee + 5 bp slippage; stress 21 bp per side; US ETF no stamp tax; turnover 2 per fully invested day
capacity: 100000 USD capital; each order <= 1% of previous day close*volume
bootstrap: seed 42, 1000 bootstrap resamples, fixed 10-day blocks, annualization 252
stop_rule: 16 fixed candidates; one run; test once; no future holdout claim
